race.comment: LAKERS LEGEND (2) turned in a solid run last start over 350m at this track finishing 4th and beaten only 1.2 lengths (20.00). Has a good record here at this journey. Better than the latest run and deserves another chance. GRETA'S GOLD (7) won again in quick time to make it two in a row, scoring at this track over 350m (19.89). Has a very good strike-rate from this draw, with three wins from five starts. In sparkling form and looks the one to beat again. PATH TO NIRVANA (1) has a fair record and proved too classy last time to win by 0.7 lengths at this track in a handy 17.18 beating Bruree Pat. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. Leading chance again. MISS CHARMED (8) was out of the money here last time out but can bounce back.
